_doc: Held-out routing scenarios for tooling/test-skill-routing.js. Each prompt is a sentence a user could type, written by hand, not copied from a trigger list. critical: the prompt must route to exactly its target under the current descriptions. ambiguous: prompts that match two or more skills on purpose, each with its exact contestant set, the declared winner and why. target null: the prompt must route to nothing. This file tests description routing, not live model selection.

ambiguous.reason: "sweep the UI" is unslop's own phrase. heal answers the bare word sweep and design the bare word ui, both weaker matches.
The whole question is learn-from-fixes' phrase. prove matches only the word qa inside it.
"archive finished sessions" is sessions' phrase. auto answers the bare word archive and commit the word push.
"tests-first review" is adversarial-loop's phrase. review matches only the word review inside it.
The task is a schema migration. billing names the table, not a payment integration.
"fix all the bugs" starts heal's sweep. prove's test run happens inside heal's fix loop.
The object of the audit is accessibility. checkout names the page, not a payment integration.
